[web - flash] Pirate Defense - set up elaborate Rube Goldberg style traps, all for catching filthy pirates

As a recommendation this one is likely to be a little hit or miss. The difficulty curve is such that it's extremely difficult at the outset until you figure out what you're doing - if you try to treat this as a tower defense game you will lose quickly. And then, once you get a strategy going, it becomes way too easy. There are several unbeatable combos.

That said, I enjoyed playing this game immensely. I just love setting up elaborate traps and watching the pirates get flung around by them. So, your experience may vary. Tragically, they never made a sequel to this one. It's just crying out for a successor which irons out the problems, but it never happened.
